explanation: The lemma is a naturality square for the library's own constructs (cocyclesOneCrossedIso, mackeyConjugateCrossed, mackeyCoefficientHom, cocyclesMap on TopRep and open subgroups). Mathlib has no continuous cohomology or Mackey-formula declarations. Its group cohomology (`groupCohomology`) is for discrete groups and has no Mackey-type crossed-homomorphism comparison. I did not grep the Mathlib sources, because the statement depends on definitions that exist only in this library.
